v1_guarantees_by_construction: packet class and admission policy are explicit
execution authorization is separate from scientific admission
approved scientific commit must be an ancestor of execution HEAD
bound scientific files must match the approved commit byte-for-byte
Git work tree must be clean at preflight
bound scientific file digests are rechecked around accepted work
engine binary SHA256 can be bound by packet
only packet-declared runtime parallelism may adapt
work units execute without a shell
work-unit stdout/stderr and attempts are preserved
POSIX work units run in independent process sessions and are terminated on timeout/interruption
accepted work units are resumable and revalidated
known byte-identical outputs may be predeclared by SHA256
completed bundle receives a full file index
bundle verification fails closed on changed accepted outputs or attempt logs
tests_added: unauthorized packets can preflight but cannot execute
bound scientific file drift fails closed
audit_requirement: Run the contributor-compute test suite from a clean checkout, execute the deterministic reference packet, inspect its bundle, and independently review packet/bundle admission semantics before merge to main.
